headline: Nigerian Stock Market Drops Amid N3.28 Trillion Sell-Off
summary: The Nigerian stock market experienced heavy losses led by declines in Dangote Cement, Presco, UACN, and HBM, resulting in a N3.28 trillion sell-off.
why: Broad market sell-offs reflect shifting investor sentiment and liquidity adjustments across major listed equities on the exchange.

impacts.name: Dangote Cement
impacts.why: Heavy losses in Dangote Cement contributed to the wider market sell-off.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: A broad correction led by major index heavyweights like Dangote Cement drove down overall market capitalization.
